title: America’s last Linotype newspaper
version: Type Directors Club archive article, 24 March 2016, and embedded photograph caption
lineage: Full page HTML contains the photographer’s image caption; the underlying Getty photograph and the newspaper issue were not independently captured. The claim that this was the last US newspaper is not relied on.

passages.locator: HTML metadata and embedded Getty photograph caption
passages.note: Dates a photograph to 18 January 2016 and describes publisher Dean Coombs producing Linotype slugs for the Saguache Crescent.
